(E) of the Tariff and Customs
Code of the Philippines is hereby amended, and a new sub-
section (f-1) is hereby added thereto, to read as follows:
"SECTION 105. Conditionally-Free Importations.
(f) Personal and household effects
belonging to residents of the Philippines
returning from abroad including jewelry,
precious stones and other articles of
luxury which were formally declared and
listed before departure and identified
under oath before the Collector of
Customs when exported from the Philippines
by such returning residents upon their
departure therefrom or during their stay
abroad; personal and household effects
including wearing apparel, articles of
personal adornment (except luxury items),

toilet articles, instruments related to
one's profession and analogous personal
or household effects, excluding vehicles,
watercraft, aircraft and animals purchased
in foreign countries by residents of the
Philippines which were necessary, appro-
priate and normally used for their comfort
and convenience during their stay abroad,
accompanying them on their return, or
arriving within a reasonable time which,
barring unforeseen and fortuitous events,
in no case shall exceed sixty (60) days
after the owner's return:
Provided, That
the personal and household effects shall
neither be in commercial quantities nor
intended for barter, sale or hire and that
the total dutiable value of which shall not
exceed Ten Thousand Pesos (P10,000.00):

hundred sixty five (365) days prior to his
Provided, finally,
That a fifty
percent (50%) ad valorem duty across the
board shall be Tevied and collected on the
personal and household effects (except
luxury items) in excess of Ten Thousand
For purposes of this section, the phrase
"returning residents" shall refer to nationals
who have stayed in a foreign country for a
period of at least six (6) months.
(f-1) In addition to the privilege
granted under the immediately preceding para-
graph, , returning overseas contract workers
shall have the privilege to bring in, duty
and tax free, used home appliances, limited
to one of every kind once in a given calendar
year accompanying them on their return, or
arriving within a reasonable time which,
barring unforeseen and fortuitous events,
in no case shall exceed sixty (60) days after
the owner's return upon presentation of their
original passport at the Port of Entry:
Provided, That any excess of Ten Thousand

Overseas Contract Workers - Holders
of valid passports duly issued by the Depart-

It covers all nationals
